impact_assessment.why: Fulfill user /goal request: deeply analyze strengths, weaknesses, and gaps; implement autonomous fleet drones, equipment upgrades shop, tactical pirate encounters, and REPL usability fixes; then publish to GitHub
impact_assessment.benefits: Transforms VoidFarer into a complete fleet simulation with modular ship upgrades, automated mining/combat drones, tactical combat, friction-free REPL, and a public GitHub presence
impact_assessment.risks: contract: REST API and CLI backward compatibility; dependency: zero external packages allowed; concurrency: thread-safe drone and state updates; state: schema migration for existing savegames
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default field values in frozen dataclasses for backward-compatible deserialization, thread mutex locking, zero external dependencies, and rigorous test coverage

impact_assessment.why: Build VoidFarer: an autonomous deep-space fleet, procedural galaxy, and holographic cockpit simulation engine with zero external dependencies
impact_assessment.benefits: Provides an engaging, high-fidelity procedural simulation engine, rich CLI, and breathtaking Web Audio/Canvas holographic cockpit HUD while adhering 100% to AIKit principles
impact_assessment.risks: contract: REST API and CLI schema alignment; dependency: zero external packages allowed; concurrency: multi-threaded HTTP server and state atomicity; state: power-loss safe storage
impact_assessment.mitigation: Frozen dataclass contracts, Python standard library only, thread-safe state mutex with atomic replace, and comprehensive sub-second test suite

checkpoints.description: [2/6] Core simulation models, procedural galaxy, and CLI REPL implemented
[1/5] Architectural audit, gap analysis, and planning for fleet management, ship upgrades, tactical combat, and publication
